method: Read apps/api/src/main.ts, worker.ts, worker.module.ts, package.json scripts, deploy/hostinger/docker-compose.yml, and grepped for worker_threads. Nothing was run in production.

processes.meaningOfLoopBlock: Every HTTP request, every WebSocket event and every webhook acknowledgement in this process waits.

hosts: BullMQ processors (see QUEUES in apps/api/src/infra/queue/queues.ts and the *.processor.ts files)
processes.meaningOfLoopBlock: Every queue's jobs and the outbox drain in this process wait; interactive API traffic is NOT affected (separate process).
gaps: Job wait/duration/outcome are fed by JobMetricsModule (one hook on every WorkerHost). Verified on a real BullMQ worker against Redis AND in the booted WorkerModule (e2e: 20+ processors carry the listeners, a real job through TemplateSweepProcessor and a real database is recorded). Retried attempts are invisible as events (BullMQ reports final states only); crm_queue_job_retries_total counts the extra starts of jobs that finished.

processes.reason: Needs apps/web/instrumentation.ts importing a shared monitor; the monitor currently lives in apps/api. Tracked in the backlog (EL-B07).

processes.entry: apps/api package.json scripts: seed:*, secrets:reencrypt, operator:create, backfill:*; offsite-backup.cli.ts; rotate-keys.cli.ts
processes.reason: By design: they exit; their synchronous work cannot block live traffic.

workerThreads: One place: apps/api/src/infra/sandbox/code-sandbox.ts starts a node:worker_threads Worker per run of the flow Code node (author JavaScript in a node:vm context, wall-clock timeout, hard kill, heap cap). It is short-lived and killed on timeout, so it is not given a long-running monitor; its cost shows up as the calling process's job duration. The first version of this inventory said there were none: that grep used a pathspec that matched nothing, and was corrected on 2026-10-15 with a plain `git grep` inside apps/api.
scheduledTasks: @nestjs/schedule and BullMQ repeatable jobs run inside api/worker above; there is no separate scheduler process.
existingTelemetryBeforeThisChange: worker heartbeat + outbox lag in Redis, surfaced in /ready
notPresentBeforeThisChange: Prometheus/Grafana services in any compose file
k6/autocannon/artillery or any load tool in the repo
containerLimits: deploy/hostinger/docker-compose.yml sets mem_limit but no cpus: or cpu quota, so cgroup CPU throttling is not expected there; crm_container_cpu_throttled_* is wired for environments that do set one.
